projects.title: Wearable ECG Patch
projects.description: A low-cost, continuous cardiac monitoring patch designed for post-operative patients. Features wireless data transmission and a 7-day battery life.
projects.content: Developed the flexible circuit substrate and managed biocompatibility testing.
projects.problem: Standard mechanical testing rigs for prosthetic knee joints are costly, non-portable, and struggle to accurately simulate cyclic human gait forces over 1 million continuous cycles.
projects.solution: Engineered a pneumatically driven cyclic simulator with real-time pressure regulation and automated load cell feedback to mimic realistic human walking dynamics efficiently.
projects.responsibilities: Designed mechanical frame in CAD, integrated pneumatic actuator valves, programmed sensor telemetry scripts, and conducted stress validation tests.
projects.features: [{"name":"Cyclic Load Simulation","description":"Simulates 1 million continuous gait cycles at controlled frequencies up to 2 Hz."},{"name":"Real-time Telemetry Dashboard","description":"Monitors force sensors and cylinder pressure in real-time with automated safety shutdown."}]
projects.challenges: [{"challenge":"Overheating in pneumatic solenoid valves during prolonged continuous testing.","solution":"Implemented pulsed actuation control logic and installed passive aluminum heat sinks."}]
projects.outcomes: Successfully tested 3 joint component iterations for 1M cycles without structural failure, reducing physical testing costs by 45%.
projects.lessons_learned: Gained deep experience in pneumatic control loops, fatigue testing standards (ISO 10328), and embedded sensor calibration.
projects.future_improvements: Add multi-axis torsional loading capabilities and cloud-based live telemetry monitoring.

projects.title: Smart Pulse Oximeter & IoT Monitor
projects.description: A wireless PPG-based pulse oximeter capable of real-time SpO2 and heart rate measurement with Bluetooth sync to a mobile dashboard.
projects.problem: Commercial medical telemetry devices are expensive and restrict continuous remote monitoring for homecare patient settings.
projects.solution: Built an affordable, high-precision photoplethysmography (PPG) module coupled with BLE transmission for continuous physiological tracking.
projects.responsibilities: Configured MAX30102 sensor drivers, designed analog filter circuits, and implemented Bluetooth Low Energy transmission protocols.
projects.features: [{"name":"Real-time SpO2 Calculation","description":"Calculates continuous arterial oxygen saturation using AC/DC ratio algorithms."},{"name":"BLE Mobile Sync","description":"Transmits live physiological data stream to companion mobile app."}]
projects.challenges: [{"challenge":"Motion artifacts distorting PPG signal waveforms during patient movement.","solution":"Applied a digital bandpass filter (0.5Hz–5Hz) and a moving average algorithm in firmware."}]
projects.outcomes: Achieved 97.4% correlation with clinical pulse oximeters during controlled validation trials.
projects.lessons_learned: Deepened knowledge of optical bio-sensing and firmware digital signal processing.
projects.future_improvements: Integrate machine learning for early detection of respiratory distress events.

projects.title: Neural Signal Processing Pipeline
projects.description: An open-source Python analytical pipeline for filtering, feature extraction, and classification of multi-channel EEG signals for Brain-Computer Interfaces.
projects.problem: EEG signals are highly noisy and require automated feature extraction tools for reliable motor imagery classification.
projects.solution: Developed an automated pipeline using wavelet transforms and Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) for robust EEG feature extraction.
projects.responsibilities: Implemented raw signal pre-processing, bandpass filtering, Welch spectral estimation, and SVM/Random Forest classifiers.
projects.features: [{"name":"Automated Artifact Rejection","description":"Removes eye blink and muscle artifacts via Independent Component Analysis (ICA)."},{"name":"Classification Benchmark","description":"Evaluates accuracy across SVM, Random Forest, and LightGBM classifiers."}]
projects.challenges: [{"challenge":"High variance across subjects during inter-subject transfer learning.","solution":"Applied Riemannian geometry manifold alignment to reduce domain shift across subjects."}]
projects.outcomes: Published open-source Python package with 88.5% classification accuracy on BCI Competition benchmark datasets.
projects.lessons_learned: Extensive expertise in biopotential signal processing and machine learning pipeline design.
projects.future_improvements: Add deep learning EEG-Net model support for end-to-end classification.

projects.description: A cloud-based web application for medical supply chain tracking, automated restock alerts, and equipment maintenance schedules.
projects.problem: Local healthcare clinics relied on manual paper logs for medical equipment maintenance and drug inventory tracking.
projects.solution: Delivered a web application with automated inventory threshold alerts, batch expiry tracking, and equipment maintenance logs.
projects.responsibilities: Designed PostgreSQL database schema, engineered Express REST APIs, and built dynamic React dashboard.
projects.features: [{"name":"Automated Restock & Expiry Alerts","description":"Notifies clinic managers before critical supplies or medications expire."},{"name":"Equipment Maintenance Logs","description":"Schedules and tracks calibration dates for biomedical equipment."}]
projects.challenges: [{"challenge":"Handling complex role-based permissions between doctors, nurses, and inventory managers.","solution":"Implemented granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) middleware."}]
projects.outcomes: Deployed across 3 community health centers, reducing supply stockouts by 60%.
projects.lessons_learned: Refined enterprise Web App architecture, database indexing, and client requirements gathering.
projects.future_improvements: Integrate barcode scanner hardware support for instant checkout.

projects.title: Biomechanical Gait Analyzer Mobile App
projects.description: A mobile application utilizing smartphone IMU sensors (accelerometer & gyroscope) to capture and evaluate gait parameters during walking.
projects.problem: Clinical gait analysis requires expensive laboratory motion capture systems not available for daily remote patient checkups.
projects.solution: Leveraged mobile device IMU sensors to compute stride time, cadence, symmetry index, and vertical oscillation.
projects.responsibilities: Built React Native cross-platform application, processed sensor fusion data, and rendered interactive motion charts.
projects.features: [{"name":"IMU Motion Capture","description":"Records 100Hz 6-DOF sensor stream during walking tests."},{"name":"Symmetry & Cadence Metrics","description":"Computes gait symmetry index and step cadence automatically."}]
projects.challenges: [{"challenge":"Filtering high-frequency sensor noise caused by phone vibration.","solution":"Applied a Complementary Filter combining accelerometer tilt and gyroscope angular velocity."}]
projects.outcomes: Published functional prototype used for remote patient gait assessment trials.
projects.lessons_learned: Improved cross-platform mobile sensor management and real-time canvas rendering.
projects.future_improvements: Add computer vision video pose estimation using device camera.

projects.title: OpenBioSignal CLI & Python SDK
projects.description: An open-source command-line tool and Python SDK for rapid parsing, conversion, and validation of WFDB, EDF, and PhysioNet bio-signal file formats.
projects.problem: Converting between different biomedical signal formats (EDF, CSV, WFDB) often requires fragmented scripts and tedious setup.
projects.solution: Engineered a unified CLI tool and lightweight Python package for seamless bio-signal dataset format conversion.
projects.responsibilities: Designed CLI interface using Click, implemented binary format decoders, and published package to PyPI.
projects.features: [{"name":"Multi-Format Conversion","description":"Convert between EDF+, WFDB DAT/HEA, and JSON formats with one command."},{"name":"Batch Validation","description":"Validates integrity and sampling rate consistency across entire dataset folders."}]
projects.challenges: [{"challenge":"Supporting legacy binary EDF header encodings without external C library dependencies.","solution":"Wrote a pure Python binary parser handling dynamic header byte offsets."}]
projects.outcomes: Over 1,200 downloads on PyPI and used by researchers for biomedical dataset preparation.
projects.lessons_learned: Gained experience in open-source software maintenance, CI/CD package publishing, and developer documentation.
projects.future_improvements: Add streaming WebSocket support for real-time hardware data ingestion.

A blog"},{"id":"b_10","type":"p","content":"differs from a traditional website in that it is usually updated more frequently"},{"id":"b_11","type":"p","content":"and provides mechanisms for readers to leave comments and share posts"},{"id":"b_12","type":"h2","content":"with others."},{"id":"b_13","type":"p","content":"With the right content and approach toward your blog and its readers you can"},{"id":"b_14","type":"p","content":"personalize your company and build a solid reputation and foundation online."},{"id":"b_15","type":"p","content":"If you produce content regularly and consistently review and respond to"},{"id":"b_16","type":"p","content":"comments, you can build a loyal readership and create a strong interaction"},{"id":"b_17","type":"p","content":"with potential and existing customers."},{"id":"b_18","type":"h2","content":"What can a blog achieve for your business?"},{"id":"b_19","type":"p","content":"Like all other social media marketing, blogs can:"},{"id":"b_20","type":"p","content":"• Establish you as an expert or thought leader in your industry boosting"},{"id":"b_21","type":"p","content":"the credibility of your company"},{"id":"b_22","type":"p","content":"• Increase traffic to your website since readers of your blog are interested"},{"id":"b_23","type":"p","content":"in your industry and likely to require the products or services you sell"},{"id":"b_24","type":"p","content":"• Raise your search engine ranking"},{"id":"b_25","type":"h2","content":"continued on page 2…"},{"id":"b_26","type":"h2","content":"WHAT’S INSIDE"},{"id":"b_27","type":"p","content":"What is a Blog? ...................................1"},{"id":"b_28","type":"h2","content":"What can a blog achieve"},{"id":"b_29","type":"p","content":"for your business?..........................1"},{"id":"b_30","type":"p","content":"Getting Started ....................................2"},{"id":"b_31","type":"p","content":"1. Before you begin, there are a number of"},{"id":"b_74","type":"h2","content":"factors to consider."},{"id":"b_75","type":"p","content":"Questions to Ask Yourself \tFactors to Consider"},{"id":"b_76","type":"h2","content":"What do I want to achieve"},{"id":"b_77","type":"h2","content":"from my blog?"},{"id":"b_78","type":"p","content":"If you want to start blogging, understand why you want to blog and what you would"},{"id":"b_79","type":"p","content":"define as being successful. Do you want to"},{"id":"b_81","type":"p","content":"personalize your company? Do you want to establish yourself as a thought leader"},{"id":"b_82","type":"h2","content":"in your industry?"},{"id":"b_83","type":"h2","content":"Do I know who I want"},{"id":"b_84","type":"h2","content":"to reach?"},{"id":"b_85","type":"p","content":"Know your audience. Keeping this in mind at all times will not only boost your efforts"},{"id":"b_87","type":"p","content":"to create compelling content but will also help you focus on your niche area"},{"id":"b_88","type":"h2","content":"of expertise."},{"id":"b_89","type":"p","content":"Have I got the passion? \tIf you want to become a thought leader or acknowledged expert in your field, then"},{"id":"b_90","type":"p","content":"you must keep yourself up to date on topics and issues in your industry. You will"},{"id":"b_91","type":"p","content":"need to continuously be aware of hot topics, advances, news and events, and"},{"id":"b_92","type":"p","content":"anything else relevant to your readers. Having this knowledge will be expected"},{"id":"b_93","type":"p","content":"by your readers and will also help you come up with content for your blog."},{"id":"b_94","type":"p","content":"Do I have the time? \tThe biggest resource required is time not only for the writing of posts but also"},{"id":"b_95","type":"p","content":"for research and keeping up to date on industry issues, responding to comments,"},{"id":"b_96","type":"p","content":"making comments on other blogs, repurposing content for other social media"},{"id":"b_97","type":"p","content":"opportunities and evaluating metrics."},{"id":"b_98","type":"p","content":"Do I have the resources? \tA successful blog requires frequency of posting and consistency. Do you have"},{"id":"b_99","type":"p","content":"staff that can help with research and content ideas? Can you assign someone to"},{"id":"b_100","type":"h2","content":"monitor comments and report metrics?"},{"id":"b_101","type":"h2","content":"Setting Objectives and Goals"},{"id":"b_102","type":"p","content":"Your ultimate goal is to attract leads and convert them into"},{"id":"b_103","type":"p","content":"sales. Unlike other marketing activities, blogging is not a"},{"id":"b_104","type":"p","content":"direct path from A to B. Take a good look at your strengths"},{"id":"b_105","type":"p","content":"and weaknesses in your market, and determine how a"},{"id":"b_106","type":"p","content":"blog might fill in any gaps. What did your research and"},{"id":"b_107","type":"p","content":"planning reveal? Do you need to raise brand awareness?"},{"id":"b_108","type":"p","content":"Would your business benefit from showcasing your"},{"id":"b_109","type":"p","content":"expertise? Are customers in your industry confused about"},{"id":"b_110","type":"p","content":"its marketplace offerings and would they appreciate some"},{"id":"b_111","type":"p","content":"clear explanations? Does your online target audience"},{"id":"b_112","type":"h2","content":"comprise avid readers or quick surfers?"},{"id":"b_113","type":"p","content":"Knowing what is needed and how a blog can provide"},{"id":"b_114","type":"p","content":"solutions will help you set your objectives and goals."},{"id":"b_115","type":"h2","content":"-- 2 of 16 --"},{"id":"b_116","type":"h2","content":"3"},{"id":"b_117","type":"h2","content":"How to Set Up Your Blog"},{"id":"b_118","type":"p","content":"Hosted Option: If you are just starting out, you may want"},{"id":"b_119","type":"p","content":"to consider creating a blog by using one of the hosted"},{"id":"b_120","type":"p","content":"plans that are free and quite easy to set up. There are a"},{"id":"b_121","type":"p","content":"number of sites, such as wordpress.com, blogger.com and"},{"id":"b_122","type":"p","content":"typepad.org, all of which offer numerous templates to"},{"id":"b_123","type":"p","content":"choose from, along with the ability to be up and running"},{"id":"b_124","type":"p","content":"literally in minutes. When using these hosted format"},{"id":"b_125","type":"h2","content":"blogs, bear in mind that:"},{"id":"b_126","type":"p","content":"• All data (text content, images, videos, audio) that you"},{"id":"b_127","type":"p","content":"upload to the blog will be hosted in the stated application"},{"id":"b_128","type":"p","content":"service so you may incur extra costs if you exceed the"},{"id":"b_129","type":"p","content":"amount of allowable hosting space. And, if the application"},{"id":"b_130","type":"p","content":"ceases to exist for whatever reason, you may end up"},{"id":"b_131","type":"p","content":"losing your data if you fail to export it in time."},{"id":"b_132","type":"p","content":"• Your web address URL typically takes on the host"},{"id":"b_133","type":"p","content":"domain, so it could look like mysitename.wordpress.com"},{"id":"b_134","type":"p","content":"or mysitename.blogger.com, etc."},{"id":"b_135","type":"p","content":"Self-hosted Option: Another approach is to set up a blog"},{"id":"b_136","type":"p","content":"application from within your existing host server where"},{"id":"b_137","type":"p","content":"your website files reside. This is typically found within"},{"id":"b_138","type":"p","content":"your host control panel administration either under the"},{"id":"b_139","type":"p","content":"folder “Simple scripts” or “Easy Scripts” or may have an"},{"id":"b_140","type":"p","content":"icon of its own. Simply double click on the blog icon and"},{"id":"b_141","type":"p","content":"follow the instructions for installation. There is no extra"},{"id":"b_142","type":"p","content":"fee for this as it is part of your hosting offerings. If you"},{"id":"b_143","type":"p","content":"wish, however, to have a customized template created"},{"id":"b_144","type":"p","content":"or to customize existing templates to follow your design"},{"id":"b_145","type":"p","content":"brand, then you may need to hire a designer to help you."},{"id":"b_146","type":"p","content":"All content data will reside within a database on your server."},{"id":"b_147","type":"h2","content":"Pros of self-hosting"},{"id":"b_148","type":"h2","content":"• Free"},{"id":"b_149","type":"h2","content":"• Easy to set up"},{"id":"b_150","type":"h2","content":"Cons of self-hosting"},{"id":"b_151","type":"p","content":"• You are responsible for keeping up with ongoing"},{"id":"b_152","type":"p","content":"application version control, plugin and theme updates."},{"id":"b_153","type":"p","content":"• You are also responsible for keeping regular back ups"},{"id":"b_154","type":"p","content":"of database and application files, which is very important."},{"id":"b_155","type":"p","content":"• You may need to hire a designer/developer to make"},{"id":"b_156","type":"h2","content":"your blog robust."},{"id":"b_157","type":"p","content":"Either method is convenient for the small business"},{"id":"b_158","type":"p","content":"owner, though the latter has more features and"},{"id":"b_159","type":"p","content":"functionality as well as scalability for growth."},{"id":"b_160","type":"h2","content":"Costs/Benefits for SMEs"},{"id":"b_161","type":"p","content":"The biggest “cost” factor is the time required to create"},{"id":"b_162","type":"p","content":"and maintain your blog. In terms of benefits, raising"},{"id":"b_163","type":"p","content":"brand recognition, credibility and respect are the more"},{"id":"b_164","type":"p","content":"obvious ones. Beyond these, there are bottom-line"},{"id":"b_165","type":"p","content":"benefits to a successful blog that are directly measurable:"},{"id":"b_166","type":"p","content":"• Blogging helps optimize your website for search"},{"id":"b_167","type":"p","content":"engines, representing a cost-effective means of"},{"id":"b_168","type":"h2","content":"driving traffic to your site."},{"id":"b_169","type":"p","content":"• If you are currently participating in a long-term"},{"id":"b_170","type":"p","content":"Pay-Per-Click advertising campaign, a blog may serve"},{"id":"b_171","type":"p","content":"to reduce these costs as natural optimization improves."},{"id":"b_172","type":"p","content":"While a blog should have a single writer—or a single"},{"id":"b_173","type":"p","content":"“voice”—to be most effective, you can get help from"},{"id":"b_174","type":"p","content":"employees to research and suggest ideas. You can also"},{"id":"b_175","type":"p","content":"assign someone to monitor comments and report"},{"id":"b_176","type":"p","content":"metrics. Understanding Best Practices"},{"id":"b_180","type":"p","content":"Because creating and maintaining a blog can be a time-consuming endeavour, you want it to be successful."},{"id":"b_181","type":"p","content":"Here are some guidelines to follow:"},{"id":"b_182","type":"p","content":"Tips for Creating a Compelling Blog"},{"id":"b_183","type":"h2","content":"Provide needed/wanted"},{"id":"b_184","type":"h2","content":"information"},{"id":"b_185","type":"p","content":"A blog is neither a sales pitch nor a corporate brochure. Provide information that"},{"id":"b_186","type":"p","content":"is valuable and educational to your customers and prospects. Your goal is to"},{"id":"b_187","type":"p","content":"establish yourself as an expert and your blog as a resource so that your business"},{"id":"b_188","type":"p","content":"will become synonymous with credibility, and then trust in the products and"},{"id":"b_189","type":"p","content":"services you offer will grow. People are also more likely to begin sharing your"},{"id":"b_190","type":"p","content":"blog with other potential customers."},{"id":"b_191","type":"p","content":"Keep it short \tYou are competing for attention with an information-laden web audience. You will"},{"id":"b_192","type":"p","content":"lose readers if it takes too long to convey your message. Keeping it short also"},{"id":"b_193","type":"p","content":"makes it easier to share, which helps build a community."},{"id":"b_194","type":"p","content":"Have a point of view \tOn one hand, you don’t want to insult or even slander someone but, on the other"},{"id":"b_195","type":"p","content":"hand, you want to be different, get noticed, and spark opinions and response"},{"id":"b_196","type":"h2","content":"from others."},{"id":"b_197","type":"p","content":"Write professionally \tNo one wants to read or share a post that is mediocre or full of errors. Make sure"},{"id":"b_198","type":"p","content":"it is grammatically correct and typo-free. If you give readers content that they are"},{"id":"b_199","type":"p","content":"proud to be associated with, they will share it with others."},{"id":"b_200","type":"p","content":"Start a conversation \tOne way to get readers to respond is to ask them a question at the end of your"},{"id":"b_201","type":"p","content":"blog. It can be as basic as “What do you think?” Your goal is to get people to leave"},{"id":"b_202","type":"p","content":"comments and share your blog with others."},{"id":"b_203","type":"p","content":"Posts with a robust comment trail are good for bloggers. Comments signal to"},{"id":"b_204","type":"p","content":"readers that the post is interesting enough to read and you are also likely to"},{"id":"b_205","type":"p","content":"increase the number of shares."},{"id":"b_206","type":"p","content":"Be a person, not a company \tIntroduce yourself by including a profile about who you are and what you do. Avoid"},{"id":"b_207","type":"p","content":"saying too much about your company. It’s also a good idea to state up front who the"},{"id":"b_208","type":"p","content":"blog content is intended for as a courtesy to busy readers."},{"id":"b_209","type":"h2","content":"Monitor and reply"},{"id":"b_210","type":"h2","content":"to comments"},{"id":"b_211","type":"p","content":"Let your readers know that you care about what they have to say by responding"},{"id":"b_212","type":"p","content":"to their posts as soon as you can. But don’t over-reply. If a conversation between"},{"id":"b_213","type":"p","content":"others evolves as a result of your blog but does not require input from you then let it be."},{"id":"b_214","type":"p","content":"Comment on other blogs \tYou can increase your readership by making thoughtful comments on the blogs"},{"id":"b_215","type":"p","content":"of other people in your industry. It is especially powerful to interact with fellow"},{"id":"b_216","type":"p","content":"bloggers who have left comments on your blog. It can cement a relationship with"},{"id":"b_217","type":"p","content":"them, plus draw their readership to your blog."},{"id":"b_218","type":"h2","content":"Don’t try to clone"},{"id":"b_219","type":"h2","content":"your website"},{"id":"b_220","type":"p","content":"Your blog design should repeat elements of your website like the graphics or colour"},{"id":"b_221","type":"p","content":"scheme and should incorporate a similar typography, but it doesn’t need to match"},{"id":"b_222","type":"p","content":"your site exactly. The idea here is to create something that resonates with your"},{"id":"b_223","type":"p","content":"website but is somewhat different."},{"id":"b_224","type":"h2","content":"continued on next page"},{"id":"b_225","type":"h2","content":"-- 4 of 16 --"},{"id":"b_226","type":"h2","content":"5"},{"id":"b_227","type":"p","content":"Tips for Creating a Compelling Blog"},{"id":"b_228","type":"p","content":"Design from the top down \tEnsure that the most important elements of your blog are prominently displayed:"},{"id":"b_229","type":"p","content":"your main content and your header, followed by your company branding. As you"},{"id":"b_230","type":"p","content":"develop your blog design, make sure that those three elements stand out above all"},{"id":"b_231","type":"p","content":"others. As well, blog post titles should stand out over any subheads within the text."},{"id":"b_232","type":"p","content":"Everything else should be designed with logic and usability in mind. For example,"},{"id":"b_233","type":"p","content":"sidebar elements should appear in the order that you would expect a reader to"},{"id":"b_234","type":"h2","content":"look for them."},{"id":"b_235","type":"h2","content":"Nuts & Bolts"},{"id":"b_236","type":"h2","content":"1. Designing Your Blog"},{"id":"b_237","type":"p","content":"Free Templates vs. Custom Designed"},{"id":"b_238","type":"p","content":"Most blogging software provides free templates as part"},{"id":"b_239","type":"p","content":"of the application or, alternatively, you can search for"},{"id":"b_240","type":"p","content":"open-source (i.e. free templates) on the Internet. They"},{"id":"b_241","type":"p","content":"typically have similar layout choices and structure but"},{"id":"b_242","type":"p","content":"differ by providing graphics that represent a variety of"},{"id":"b_243","type":"p","content":"industries. You can usually search by category or type of"},{"id":"b_244","type":"p","content":"blog you want to develop. Some free templates offer you"},{"id":"b_245","type":"p","content":"colour and font options but tend to limit your ability to"},{"id":"b_246","type":"h2","content":"customize beyond that."},{"id":"b_247","type":"p","content":"It is important that your blog reflects well on your company."},{"id":"b_248","type":"p","content":"That includes content, first and foremost but it also"},{"id":"b_249","type":"p","content":"means conveying your branding and professionalism"},{"id":"b_250","type":"p","content":"visually. Your blog design can have a huge impact on"},{"id":"b_251","type":"p","content":"how it is perceived. While many small business bloggers"},{"id":"b_252","type":"p","content":"start with basic templates offered by vendors such as"},{"id":"b_253","type":"p","content":"WordPress, they often find themselves upgrading to a"},{"id":"b_254","type":"p","content":"customized solution over time."},{"id":"b_255","type":"p","content":"Custom designed templates can be found through"},{"id":"b_256","type":"p","content":"various websites or you can have your own designer"},{"id":"b_257","type":"p","content":"develop it. The premium themed templates offered on the"},{"id":"b_258","type":"p","content":"Internet are available for a range of fees depending on"},{"id":"b_259","type":"p","content":"the complexity of the theme offerings. You can either buy"},{"id":"b_260","type":"p","content":"a licence to use a premium themed template or you can"},{"id":"b_261","type":"p","content":"purchase it outright for your exclusive use."},{"id":"b_262","type":"h2","content":"2. Developing a Content Plan"},{"id":"b_263","type":"h2","content":"and Timeline"},{"id":"b_264","type":"p","content":"With some upfront planning, writing a timely, consistent"},{"id":"b_265","type":"p","content":"blog does not have to be a daunting commitment. Many"},{"id":"b_266","type":"p","content":"business blogs are published weekly so that can be a"},{"id":"b_267","type":"h2","content":"good frequency as a start."},{"id":"b_268","type":"p","content":"Begin by choosing an overall topic/focus for your blogs,"},{"id":"b_269","type":"p","content":"and then create an editorial calendar that lists specific"},{"id":"b_270","type":"p","content":"topics you would like to cover. You do not want your overall"},{"id":"b_271","type":"p","content":"focus to be so specific that it will be too challenging to"},{"id":"b_272","type":"p","content":"come up with content but you also don’t want topics to be"},{"id":"b_273","type":"p","content":"so wide ranging that readers have no idea how they relate"},{"id":"b_274","type":"p","content":"to your business. If they are unsure about whether or not"},{"id":"b_275","type":"p","content":"your blog will cover something of interest to them, you"},{"id":"b_276","type":"p","content":"could lose them. The idea is to carve out a niche for you."},{"id":"b_277","type":"p","content":"Do not be alarmed if your editorial calendar has a few"},{"id":"b_278","type":"p","content":"blank spots. If you keep on top of industry issues and"},{"id":"b_279","type":"h2","content":"trends, topics will emerge."},{"id":"b_280","type":"p","content":"TIP: Keep track of your customers’ buying cycles"},{"id":"b_281","type":"p","content":"throughout the year on your editorial calendar. That"},{"id":"b_282","type":"p","content":"way you can ramp up content and ensure that your"},{"id":"b_283","type":"p","content":"posts are timely and relevant. You can even include"},{"id":"b_284","type":"p","content":"a stronger marketing message or additional link to"},{"id":"b_285","type":"h2","content":"your website."},{"id":"b_286","type":"h2","content":"-- 5 of 16 --"},{"id":"b_287","type":"h2","content":"6"},{"id":"b_288","type":"p","content":"3. If you use multimedia,"},{"id":"b_292","type":"p","content":"remember to keep the search engines in mind and offer"},{"id":"b_293","type":"p","content":"video transcripts or alternative tags to describe images,"},{"id":"b_294","type":"p","content":"as they are not recognized by search engines."},{"id":"b_295","type":"p","content":"In addition, remember to provide proper credit for any"},{"id":"b_296","type":"p","content":"materials you use from external sources."},{"id":"b_297","type":"h2","content":"4. Administered through your blog post editing"},{"id":"b_637","type":"p","content":"page, SEO (Search Engine Optimization) tagging is the"},{"id":"b_638","type":"p","content":"process of adding tags (i.e. keywords) to each of your blog"},{"id":"b_639","type":"p","content":"posts to help search engines find your relevant content."},{"id":"b_640","type":"p","content":"Here are some strategies to assist with tagging:"},{"id":"b_641","type":"p","content":"• Use tools to research what others are writing about"},{"id":"b_642","type":"p","content":"in your industry. If you are just starting out, you can"},{"id":"b_643","type":"p","content":"access tools to first identify the keywords that your"},{"id":"b_644","type":"p","content":"audience would use to search for your offerings. To"},{"id":"b_645","type":"p","content":"help you identify those keywords, investigate various"},{"id":"b_646","type":"p","content":"blog directories, type “http://keyword:blog” in the"},{"id":"b_647","type":"p","content":"search bar, or go to Google search, type in the keyword,"},{"id":"b_648","type":"p","content":"then select blogs in the filter. This will give you a feel"},{"id":"b_649","type":"p","content":"for what people are writing about in your industry."},{"id":"b_650","type":"p","content":"You can also set up Google Alerts, which will email"},{"id":"b_651","type":"p","content":"you whenever something is being written about a"},{"id":"b_652","type":"h2","content":"particular topic."},{"id":"b_653","type":"p","content":"• Use keywords. When writing your blog try to use the"},{"id":"b_654","type":"p","content":"keywords and phrases that you have identified so that"},{"id":"b_655","type":"p","content":"your target audience will find you."},{"id":"b_656","type":"p","content":"• Write unique content. Posting content in your own"},{"id":"b_657","type":"p","content":"voice and including your opinion not only will make"},{"id":"b_658","type":"p","content":"you more interesting to readers and strengthen your"},{"id":"b_659","type":"p","content":"position in the community it will also make your blog"},{"id":"b_660","type":"p","content":"more valuable for search bots."},{"id":"b_661","type":"p","content":"• Submit your blog site to Google and blog directories."},{"id":"b_662","type":"p","content":"Examples include www.blogscanada.ca,"},{"id":"b_663","type":"p","content":"http://thecanadianblogdirectory.com/ and"},{"id":"b_664","type":"p","content":"http://photoblogdirectory.net/Canada/."},{"id":"b_665","type":"p","content":"• Develop a linking strategy. This includes linking your"},{"id":"b_666","type":"p","content":"current post to your previously-published posts. This"},{"id":"b_667","type":"p","content":"will increase the chances of search bots discovering"},{"id":"b_668","type":"p","content":"both current and past posts and will also encourage"},{"id":"b_669","type":"p","content":"readers to check out previous posts. Also consider"},{"id":"b_670","type":"p","content":"linking to other writers’ blog posts and building inbound"},{"id":"b_671","type":"p","content":"links by asking them to link back to you. Always"},{"id":"b_685","type":"p","content":"do a backup of your database and application prior"},{"id":"b_686","type":"p","content":"to any major updates.
